title: A representation of a sum of two IMRep actions has the summed vector density
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, let U ⊆ ℝ^P be open, let R₁ = (M₁, θ₁, ξ₁), R₂ = (M₂, θ₂, ξ₂) and R = (M, θ, ξ) be integer multiplicity triples in U (IMRep U n, Simon Ch. 6, 3.1), and let T ∈ 𝒟_n(U) (GeometricCurrentOn U n). Write τ(R')(ω) := R'.action ω = ∫_{M'} θ'(x)ξ'(x)(ω(x)) dHⁿ(x) (Hⁿ = μHE[n]). Assume R represents T (T(ω) = τ(R)(ω) for every ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(U)) and T(ω) = τ(R₁)(ω) + τ(R₂)(ω) for every ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(U). Then for Hⁿ-a.e. x ∈ ℝ^P the n-vectors in MultiVector P n satisfy 1_M(x)θ(x)ξ(x) = 1_{M₁}(x)θ₁(x)ξ₁(x) + 1_{M₂}(x)θ₂(x)ξ₂(x) (written with Set.indicator and real scalar multiplication).
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (R₁ R₂ R : IMRep U n) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n), IsOpen U → R.Represents T → (∀ ω : TestFormOn U n, T ω = R₁.action (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) + R₂.action (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n)) → ∀ᵐ x ∂μHE[n], R.carrier.indicator (fun y => (R.mult y : ℝ) • R.orient y) x = R₁.carrier.indicator (fun y => (R₁.mult y : ℝ) • R₁.orient y) x + R₂.carrier.indicator (fun y => (R₂.mult y : ℝ) • R₂.orient y) x
